title: The Sunlit Man
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: A hunted wanderer arrives on a world where a lethal sun sweeps across the land, forcing everyone to keep moving ahead of it. A fast standalone adventure in a larger shared universe of fantasy worlds.
readIf: you like a fast, inventive adventure with an odd setting and a lot of action.
skipIf: you want a character study, as this prefers set pieces and plot to quiet moments.

pairings.reason: Another story of a hostile world with strict rules for survival and a hero who must adapt.
A lone, haunted traveller moves across a strange, scoured landscape in pursuit of someone.
The same author's tighter fantasy with a similar love of clever magic and twists.
